dialogues.jp: こめかみを押さえて音夢を指差した。
dialogues.en: I pressed my temple and pointed at Nemu with my finger.
dialogues.text: I pressed my temple and pointed at Nemu with my finger.

dialogues.jp:
髪をわさわさと揺らして、音夢がデス声をしぼ
りだす。
dialogues.en: Nemu waved her hair and yelled out using her scary voice.
dialogues.text: Nemu waved her hair and yelled out using her scary voice.

dialogues.jp: じわじわ、と髪が持ち上がっているような。
dialogues.en: It seems like her hair's standing up.
dialogues.text: It seems like her hair's standing up.

dialogues.jp:
そろそろ、音夢の拳に大気圏を突破出来るくら
いのエネルギーが溜められてる気がする……。
dialogues.en:
I think her fist has charged enough energy to punch me
through the atmosphere.
dialogues.text:
I think her fist has charged enough energy to punch me
through the atmosphere.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あのね、わざわざ息切れするほど……くしゅ
　ん」
dialogues.en: "So you came running as fast as you could...... cough."
dialogues.text: "So you came running as fast as you could...... cough."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ん……は、走りこんで、そんな悪口言いに来
　たの！？」

言いたいことはまだまだたくさんあったが、俺
はそれを全部呑み込んだ。
「まぁ、大丈夫そうで良かったよ」
dialogues.en: I smiled and put my hand on top of her head.
dialogues.text: I smiled and put my hand on top of her head.

dialogues.jp:
しおしお、とガスが抜けるように音夢が借りて
きた猫みたいな目で俺を見上げる。

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Sorry to bother you all the time."
dialogues.text: "Sorry to bother you all the time."

dialogues.jp: そっ、と音夢の手が俺の胸に触れる。
dialogues.en: Nemu put her hand gently on my chest.
dialogues.text: Nemu put her hand gently on my chest.

dialogues.jp: 「そう言うな。約束したからな」
その手に自分の手を重ねて微笑む。
dialogues.en: I put my hand over her hand and smiled.
dialogues.text: I put my hand over her hand and smiled.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "But it was a nosebleed this time."
dialogues.text: "But it was a nosebleed this time."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さん……今なら格安で片道月面旅行が出来
　るみたいなんだけど？」
dialogues.en:
"Niisan... did you know that a one way ticket to the moon is
really cheap right now?"
dialogues.text:
"Niisan... did you know that a one way ticket to the moon is
really cheap right now?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや……悪かった、キャンセルしてくれ」

音夢から離れようとしたのだが、さきほど重ね
た手がなぜか絡み取られていた。
dialogues.en:
I try to move away from Nemu, but she took my hand so I
couldn't move.
dialogues.text:
I try to move away from Nemu, but she took my hand so I
couldn't move.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「キャンセルで叩き込んでいいのね♪」
dialogues.en: "Don't be shy. You can still enjoy the moon."
dialogues.text: "Don't be shy. You can still enjoy the moon."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "You sound like someone from an arcade fighting game......"
dialogues.text: "You sound like someone from an arcade fighting game......"

dialogues.jp:
杉並とは互角に戦えるのだが、どうしても音夢
には勝てない気がする……いやマジで。
dialogues.en:
I'm sure I'm at the same level as Suginami, but I don't
think I can win against Nemu. Seriously.
dialogues.text:
I'm sure I'm at the same level as Suginami, but I don't
think I can win against Nemu. Seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい！　バカなことやってないで」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Is it me? You think it's my fault?"
dialogues.text: "Is it me? You think it's my fault?"

dialogues.jp:
突然、顔の下半分を押さえて音夢が身体を丸め
る。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, Nemu rolled her body covering the lower part of
her face.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, Nemu rolled her body covering the lower part of
her face.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、いや、ちょっと鼻の奥にくるものが……」
dialogues.en: "I don't know. But I felt something in the back of my nose."
dialogues.text: "I don't know. But I felt something in the back of my nose."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「仕方ないでしょうが！　好きでやってるわけ
　じゃないんだから！」
dialogues.en: "It's not my fault! I'm not doing this on purpose."
dialogues.text: "It's not my fault! I'm not doing this on purpose."

dialogues.jp: 首の鈴を鳴らして猫が｛いかく／威嚇｝してくる。
dialogues.en:
She's acting like a mad cat trying to scare me, ringing the
bell at her neck.
dialogues.text:
She's acting like a mad cat trying to scare me, ringing the
bell at her neck.

dialogues.jp: 「あのよ。そろそろ漫才やってないで帰ろう」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから兄さんのせいでしょうが……」

歩き出そうとして、なにかを忘れている気がふ
つふつと……。
dialogues.en:
I felt I might be forgetting something as I was about to
walk.
dialogues.text:
I felt I might be forgetting something as I was about to
walk.

dialogues.jp:
こういう時は、なにか思い出すと面倒なことが
起こるような気がするし。
dialogues.en:
In the case like this, I should let it go, or I might end up
in trouble.
dialogues.text:
In the case like this, I should let it go, or I might end up
in trouble.

dialogues.jp: 俺の背中を、少し慌てた声と手が押す。
「なんだ、見たいドラマでもあるのか？」
dialogues.en: "What? Do you have some soap opera you want to watch?"
dialogues.text: "What? Do you have some soap opera you want to watch?"

dialogues.jp: かくっ、と音夢の手が離れた。
dialogues.en: I felt her hands off my back.
dialogues.text: I felt her hands off my back.

dialogues.jp:
慌てて振り返った先で、音夢が地面に膝をつい
ていた。
dialogues.en:
I turned around in a hurry, and found her kneeling on the
ground.
dialogues.text:
I turned around in a hurry, and found her kneeling on the
ground.

dialogues.jp: ぼぅとした表情を浮かべた後。
ぽて、っと顔から音夢が倒れた。
dialogues.en: And she fell onto the ground.
dialogues.text: And she fell onto the ground.

dialogues.jp:
心配して損をしたとため息をつく俺に、音夢が
また頬をふくらませる。
dialogues.en:
I complained because I was so worried about her. And Nemu
puffed her cheeks at me.
dialogues.text:
I complained because I was so worried about her. And Nemu
puffed her cheeks at me.

dialogues.jp:
本当はなにもなくて良かった、と言いたかった
のに、憎まれ口を叩いてしまう俺だが……。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to say I was glad nothing bad happened to her, but
I was shy and I couldn't say it to her......
dialogues.text:
I wanted to say I was glad nothing bad happened to her, but
I was shy and I couldn't say it to her......

dialogues.jp:
と、なんでもなかったはずの音夢が、急に口元
を押さえて倒れてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I thought Nemu was fine, but then she collapsed, covering
her mouth with her hand.
dialogues.text:
I thought Nemu was fine, but then she collapsed, covering
her mouth with her hand.
